I chose this place because I love nature and the villa atmosphere.

Although it is a bit far from the city center, requiring some travel, it was convenient for my Hoi An itinerary. There is a shuttle service to Da Nang and Hoi An, and upon check-in, a dedicated staff member is assigned, allowing for convenient communication via KakaoTalk. Elena, who was in charge of us, communicated very quickly and responded kindly. I left my phone in a Grab taxi, but she actively communicated with the night shift staff member and helped me find it.

If there is a slight downside, it is that the breakfast taste is so-so, and since there are only two menu options, there isn't much to eat if you stay for a long time.

Our family of six stayed for 3 nights in a 3-bedroom suite. The views were beautiful everywhere, and the water quality of both the main pool and the pools within the accommodation was well-maintained. I especially loved that our assigned manager checked in daily via KakaoTalk to make sure we were comfortable!

In particular, the free 50-minute massage every day was a huge hit with my parents... lol. That was truly the best part.

I do regret not booking one more day... My elementary school-aged kids said they want to come back to this place next time and not look for any other accommodations.

text:
An Even More Wonderful Second Stay at Naman Retreat – Special Thanks to Min!

I first visited Naman Retreat nine years ago and had such wonderful memories that I decided to return, this time with my husband and son. And I’m so happy I did!

What made our second visit even more special was our amazing Personal Ambassador, Min.

When I mentioned that I had stayed here nine years ago, Min surprised us with thoughtful complimentary treats, including wine, cake, and milk, to celebrate our return. It was such a lovely gesture that made us feel truly welcomed and appreciated.

Throughout our stay, Min was incredibly attentive, kind, and efficient. From arranging and rescheduling spa appointments to taking care of every little request, Min was always just a KakaoTalk message away. Whatever we needed, Min handled it quickly and effortlessly. Having someone so reliable and caring made our stay even more relaxing and enjoyable. Min was truly our problem-solver and made us feel completely at ease!

Of course, Naman Retreat itself remains as beautiful as I remembered. I absolutely love its peaceful, nature-inspired atmosphere. It’s the perfect place to escape the busy world, unwind, and recharge.

The dining experiences were also fantastic! We thoroughly enjoyed our delicious dinner at B-Lounge, and the Asian Grill & Hot Pot with live band performances was another highlight of our stay. Great food, beautiful surroundings, and live music made for such memorable evenings.

Nine years later, Naman Retreat still holds a special place in my heart, and this second visit was even more meaningful thanks to Min’s exceptional hospitality.

Thank you so much, Min, for making our family vacation truly unforgettable! We will definitely be back again!

textTranslated: I stayed at Babylon for 7 nights. It deserves more than 5 stars—it deserves 100. In terms of facilities, service, scenery, location, and breakfast (you say the variety is limited? Not at all!), I can say it is by far the best resort I have ever visited on an overseas trip. In particular, the dedicated manager's KakaoTalk chat service is truly smart and friendly. From how they handled things and the speed of their response to their kindness... it is a service that makes even the smallest inconvenience feel pleasant. (Thank you, dedicated manager Min!) The location is situated between the city center and Hoi An, so it offers good accessibility to both, and there are shuttle buses for both, allowing you to save on taxi fares. Although some say the breakfast selection is a bit limited, by our standards, it was a satisfying breakfast that we fully enjoyed. There are three pools: the Apartment Pool, the Babylon Pool, and the Main Pool. The Main Pool even has a heated spa.^^ Finally, one thing I can't forget!! Midway through the trip, I was worried because I had cold symptoms (fever, cough, etc.), but there is a resident nurse at the resort. She came over, took my temperature, and prescribed medicine (this is truly insane service). Thanks to her, I recovered quickly and was able to complete the rest of my itinerary without any problems. (White Angel HAU. I can’t thank you enough for all your help. I really appreciate it. Thank you so much.) If anyone says they are coming to Da Nang, tell them to shut up and book this place!! Tell them to book the Retreat exclusively for me!! They will feel the ultimate satisfaction!! Thank you to all the staff at the resort^^

textTranslated:
I had a truly relaxing and leisurely time at Naman Retreat with my parents 😊

We stayed in a Three Bedroom Pool Villa. The room was spacious and well-maintained, making it perfect for a family stay. The private pool in the villa was large and had a great atmosphere, so we enjoyed using it leisurely during our stay. The overall landscaping and ambiance of the resort were so beautiful that just taking a walk felt like a healing experience.

Above all, my parents said they rested very well without any inconveniences because the accommodation was comfortable and quiet, which made me very satisfied as well.

Also, I was very grateful to Manager Katie for taking such attentive care of us throughout our stay. It was convenient to be able to communicate immediately via KakaoTalk whenever we needed something, and thanks to her constantly checking to see if we had any discomforts or needed anything, we were able to stay even more comfortably ❤️

We also booked and used the spa in advance; it was great for relieving travel fatigue and was wonderful for spending time relaxing at the resort.

All the staff were kind, and the overall service was attentive, so we had a restful stay without any particular inconveniences. It was an even more satisfying stay because I was able to relax comfortably with my parents.

If I come back to Da Nang, I would definitely like to visit Naman Retreat again 😊
text:
부모님과 함께 Naman Retreat에서 정말 편안하고 여유로운 시간을 보내고 왔어요 😊

Three Bedroom Pool Villa에서 지냈는데 객실도 넓고 깔끔하게 관리되어 있어서 가족끼리 머물기에 정말 좋았습니다. 빌라에 있는 프라이빗 풀도 넓고 분위기가 좋아서 머무는 동안 여유롭게 잘 이용했고, 리조트 전체적인 조경과 분위기도 너무 예뻐서 산책하는 것만으로도 힐링되는 느낌이었어요.

무엇보다 부모님도 숙소가 편안하고 조용해서 머무는 동안 불편함 없이 정말 잘 쉬셨다고 하셔서 저도 만족스러웠습니다.

그리고 Katie 매니저님께서 머무는 동안 계속 세심하게 챙겨주셔서 정말 감사했어요. 필요한 게 있으면 카톡으로 바로 소통할 수 있어서 편했고, 먼저 불편한 점이나 필요한 부분이 없는지 계속 챙겨주셔서 덕분에 더욱 편하게 지낼 수 있었습니다 ❤️

스파도 미리 예약해서 이용했는데 여행 중 피로를 풀기에 정말 좋았고, 리조트에서 여유롭게 쉬면서 시간을 보내기에도 너무 좋았어요.

직원분들도 모두 친절하시고 전체적으로 서비스가 세심해서 머무는 동안 특별히 불편한 점 없이 잘 쉬다 왔습니다. 부모님과 함께 편안하게 휴식할 수 있어서 더욱 만족스러운 숙박이었어요.

다낭에 다시 오게 된다면 Naman Retreat은 꼭 다시 방문하고 싶습니다 😊

textTranslated: I felt very comfortable during my few days at the resort, and it was also convenient for business trips. The staff were lovely too. On the last day, I had a sore throat and could barely speak. I went to the medical room to see Ms. Diem for medication, and she gave me very thorough instructions and advised me on what to avoid because I had a meeting two days later. Thank you for the hospitality of the staff here; it made me feel that my stay at this resort was well worth it! ❤️
